correctness.rationale: For connected GP(10,2) the symmetric edge polytope is 19-dimensional and polar extreme points are exactly normalized integer unit-edge-Lipschitz potentials with connected tight-edge graph. The included exhaustive C++ recursion visits all 14,607,387 integral assignments, checks connectivity, returns 3,678,208 facets and the six incidence bins, and maximizes \(T=20\|\bar f\|_2^2\) at precisely 580 on the 20 distance functions. The included Python exact determinant computation gives a 10-by-10 minor -2, while antipodal distance pairs give upper bound 10, hence 9-dimensional optimal-center affine hull. Every source has been executed successfully; the arguments explicitly ensure finite enumeration is exhaustive.

value.rationale: A complete facial census and contact geometry for the canonical dodecahedral graph metric describes motivated 19-dimensional Lipschitz-free Banach geometry rather than a contrived slice. The exact contact-normal rank explains why an insphere touching only 20 out of more than 3.6 million facets has a 9-dimensional family of centers; facet incidence multiplicities supply an exact reproducibility benchmark. Does not pretend to prove an infinite-family theorem.
